name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
summary: At South Gate Outpost, Mountaineer Barleybrew watches the pass from Dun Morogh toward Loch Modan. He relies on dwarven brews to help sentries endure the cold.

sections.title: A Watch on the Eastern Pass
sections.body: Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew watches the snowy road to Loch Modan from South Gate Outpost. He is part of Ironforge's border watch. Like other mountaineers in Dun Morogh's bitter winds, he values the strength of fine dwarven drink. His name links him to the renowned Barleybrew clan. He also helps send potent Shimmer Stout to fellow watchmen who need warmth and stamina during long shifts in the mountain passes.

faq.q: Where can I find Mountaineer Barleybrew?
faq.answer: You can find Mountaineer Barleybrew at South Gate Outpost, the dwarven fortification guarding the eastern pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: What is his duty at South Gate Outpost?
faq.answer: At South Gate Outpost, he watches the roadway and helps arrange supplies, including Shimmer Stout for mountaineers stationed throughout the passes.

faq.q: Is he related to the other Barleybrews?
faq.answer: Yes. Rejold Barleybrew, the brewer, is his brother. Barleybrew may also be related to Marleth, Malgin, and Yorus Barleybrew.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the demands of frontier duty and the high-proof drink that helps keep Khaz Modan secure.
